stable.release_notes:
PipraPay v3.0.2 Major UI/UX & Engine Update:
• Complete Redesign of System Update page with interactive 4-step workflow.
• Realtime animated progress bar & live deployment status console.
• Instant Alert & Multi-Channel Notification Engine (Telegram Bot, Discord Webhook, WhatsApp API, Custom SMTP Email, and SMS Gateway).
• Granular Event Routing Matrix & Device Disconnect / Low Battery Alerts.
• Pre-flight server health diagnostics & system compatibility check.
• Automated pre-update safety backup snapshots.
• Manual ZIP archive uploader for offline environments.
• Performance optimizations and bug fixes.
